Stay & Learn

Spend a Weekend With the People Who Built It

Stay in a real container home. Learn how it was designed, built, and lived in. Leave with ideas you can actually use.

Request a Stay

This isn't a vacation rental with a gimmick.

Sustainabox is a real home built over several years by people who documented every success, mistake, and lesson. Your stay includes access to that experience—so you leave with ideas you can actually use.

What's Included

More Than a Place to Stay

Stay in a Real Container Home

Not a showroom. Not a concept. The home we designed, built, and live in — three shipping containers configured into a modern, comfortable space.

Learn Every System

Spend four hours exploring how we built Sustainabox — from foundation to finishes — with honest conversations about what worked and what we'd change.

Modern, Comfortable Living

Fast Wi-Fi, full kitchen, climate control, and everything you'd expect from a modern home — just built differently.

Your Hosts

Meet Your Hosts

Jen Swidler

Builder · General Contractor

Jen managed the Sustainabox build from foundation to finishes and documented the entire journey. She knows every system, every trade, every challenge, and every lesson learned.

Cody Swidler

Founder · Designer

Cody designed Sustainabox in SketchUp and helped bring the vision to life. Today, he's focused on growing Sustainabox into a resource for smarter container home design and resilient living.

Skye

Creative & Builder

Skye contributed to the design, construction, and storytelling behind Sustainabox, helping capture the project from concept to completion.
